title: Sass and CSS Custom Properties knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which mental model best explains “Sass and CSS Custom Properties” in Dart Sass?
options: Sass extends CSS with a compile-time layer for reusable values, expressions, rules, and module organization. The compiler transforms the source file into ordinary CSS; the browser does not execute Sass syntax.
The browser executes Sass source directly, so a compilation step is unnecessary.
Readable SCSS guarantees correct browser rendering, accessibility, and performance without output review.
The best solution is always to replace native CSS behavior with a new Sass abstraction.
questions.answer_key: Sass extends CSS with a compile-time layer for reusable values, expressions, rules, and module organization. The compiler transforms the source file into ordinary CSS; the browser does not execute Sass syntax.
questions.explanation: Sass extends CSS with a compile-time layer for reusable values, expressions, rules, and module organization.
